Class CashTransaction

java.lang.Object
app.cash.CashTransactionBase
app.cash.CashTransaction
@Entity public class CashTransaction extends CashTransactionBase
One append-only cash movement (BR-09/14/15).

The ledger is the source of truth for cash; the balance it backs is the owning user's users.available_funds. Never move that balance without inserting the matching row here in the same transaction. The opening funds a client registers with are booked here as their first deposit, so the ledger sums to the balance from the start (BR-10).

A row is keyed by an account because the schema requires one, but cash belongs to the user and every account of theirs shares it. A deposit or withdrawal is booked against the user's first account; an ORDER_FILL row is booked against the account the order was placed for.
